meta.name: Mathagam
meta.description: A "dead" gangster resurrects, and he is a man with an elaborate plan. With the city under threat, IPS officer Ashwath's only choice is to be two steps ahead...

videos.title: Scent of Crime
videos.overview: DCP Ashwath learns of a party to be organised by a long-defunct gangster. As he begins a covert operation, Padalam Sekar gears up for his resurrection.

videos.title: Ulterior Motive
videos.overview: As Sekar gears up for the party, Ashwath tries to contact a police informer. Commissioner Sayanthika digs up an old case to distract Sekar's powerful ally, Minister Veeravel Nalangilli.

videos.title: Combat Stance
videos.overview: Sekar takes Coin Siva's family hostage. With Nalangilli sending a veiled threat to the commissioner, how will Ashwath track the gangsters?

videos.title: Band Trip
videos.overview: Sayanthika orders to speed up the mission. While Ashwath faces a family emergency, Sekar becomes wary of Mottamuni. Will the party happen?

videos.title: Battle Begins
videos.overview: Sekar learns of the police operation, and Nalangilli proves just how powerful he can be. Just as the mission is called off, help arrives from unexpected quarters.

videos.title: The Purge
videos.overview: Thirumaran messes with Nalangilli's plans. The party begins, and the big secret gets disclosed. As Ashwath closes in, Sekar ups his game.

videos.title: Red Rag
videos.overview: Ashwath gathers explosive information from an insider. Sekar suffers a huge setback. Is this the end of the hide-and-seek game?

videos.title: Battering Ram
videos.overview: Sekar and others try to escape after locking the hostages in a bomb-laden room. During the chaos that follows, guns and money decide everyone's fate.

videos.title: First Light
videos.overview: Thirumaaran receives an official complaint against Nalankilli. Sekar gets surrounded by Ashwath. As the end nears, a mysterious force is revealed.
